entries.reason: the release carries the route query but not the question the class exists to answer. In the armv7 shared cache of 6.1.3 (568965 names, armv7): AVAudioSession, currentRoute, outputs, AVAudioSessionPortDescription, portName, portType, routeForCategory: and UIActionSheet are all present, and so are AVPlayer's allowsExternalPlayback, externalPlaybackActive and usesExternalPlaybackWhileExternalScreenIsActive. What is missing is any way to say which output is the one in use and which is an alternative: isWireless is absent (first rung 16.0, measured) and AVAudioSessionRouteDescription carries no property that names the current output - the port's own compile of a first attempt failed on exactly that, `property 'port' not found`. The list of AirPlay targets is not public API on this release either

entries.reason: not for want of the layer it drives. AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer IS on this release - in the armv7 shared cache of 6.1.3 (568965 names, armv7) with its class and metaclass symbols, first rung 6.0, earlier than the 14.0 its own header suggests. No release before 15.0 has picture-in-picture at all (AVPictureInPictureController first appears at 9.0 and never asks a sample-buffer layer to play), so the six-method protocol that would drive one has nothing to talk to. The port's picture-in-picture reparents a real AVPlayerLayer instead, which is the half this port carries

entries.reason: a time range is only meaningful against an item that carries interstitial markers, and neither half exists on this release: the class first appears at 16.0, and in the armv7 shared cache of 6.1.3 (568965 names, armv7) there is no `interstitialTimeRanges` and no `insertInterstitialTimeRange`. The release does carry the ranges that DO exist - seekableTimeRanges and loadedTimeRanges are both present - which is what makes the absence specific rather than general: the port can talk about when media is playable, and has nothing to mark an advertisement inside it
